description: Language 'und' (undetermined) is used where the source gives a country but no language. Relationships between personal-name forms attested in real aggregate data (naming profiles), never invented: spelling variants that co-occur as frequent forms, and negative constraints between names that are registered as distinct. All edges are proposed until a human reviewer with a role reviews them.
